daily_external_review: Already completed 2026-11-26; see research/pequalnp-watch.md. No external theorem imported.
decision: Retain the optional independently owned cold batch for multiple snapshots sharing a context, policy and trace bound. Return to strengthened residual coverage; no further identical exhausted B12 replay is needed.
limitations: Fourteen exposed cases, eighteen snapshots per policy, four balanced timing repetitions; gains concentrate in the two three-snapshot cases.
Every snapshot is independently replayed and proof-checked; no discovery state or cross-call authority is trusted. Common preparation alone is shared.
Snapshots need not be consecutive and the API does not certify completeness of their list or search budgets. The audit separately checks exact equality with all saved rounds.
Mixed trace bounds require separate batches. Open completions retain the pre-existing honest-history assumption; no SAT verdict follows from exhaustion.
Seven source-order and two unseen single-snapshot checking regressions remain; persistence regresses despite unchanged implementation and bytes.
Peak RSS increases slightly and snapshot bytes remain unchanged. Owning all snapshots can use more memory than individual streaming checks. Retained evidence still grows.
No new implication, coverage, native certificate, production default or unrestricted-SAT resource bound. Startup/loading, acquisition, pilots, native compilation and audits are additional.
next_cost_target: Discovery, independent checking and reconstruction now each take roughly a third of runtime. Profile the next changed-bank coverage experiment before choosing another optimization.
